card.title: Manufacturing Growth Program Director
card.description:
**Manufacturing Growth Program Director**

**ROLE PURPOSE** 
Provide strategic, financial, and program leadership for major manufacturing growth, capacity, investment, vertical integration, and M&A initiatives. The role connects strategy, economics, financial analysis, and operational execution to improve capital allocation, surface risks early, and enable fact-based executive decisions.

This is not a traditional PMO role. The individual will challenge assumptions, identify what does not reconcile across operational and financial information, quantify the implications, and recommend corrective action.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Manufacturing Strategy & Investment

* Support development and execution of the multi-year manufacturing growth, capacity, footprint, and investment strategy.
* Evaluate brownfield and greenfield expansion, outsourcing, localization, make-versus-buy, vertical integration, partnerships, and acquisitions.
* Develop business cases and scenarios linking investments to capacity, revenue, margin, productivity, cash flow, ROIC, customer service, and strategic advantage.
* Assess whether proposed investments align with strategic priorities and represent the highest-value deployment of capital.

2. M&A, Vertical Integration & Strategic Transactions

* Support buy-side evaluation of manufacturing businesses, assets, technologies, suppliers, and capability acquisitions.
* Develop the strategic and economic rationale for acquisitions and vertical integration, including fit with business priorities and the expected accretive value proposition.
* Evaluate valuation assumptions, revenue and cost synergies, EBITDA and cash-flow impact, working capital, CapEx, integration costs, ROIC, NPV/IRR, and time-to-value.
* Build base, upside, and downside cases; identify key sensitivities and potential sources of value creation or destruction.
* Assess operational, financial, supply-chain, customer, technology, capacity, and integration risks during diligence.
* Support post-acquisition value-capture plans with accountable owners, milestones, and metrics for synergy and investment-thesis realization.

3. Business, Financial & Economic Analysis

* Analyze CapEx and OpEx performance against plan, approved business cases, and expected returns.
* Connect volume, mix, material, labor, productivity, utilization, yield, working capital, margin, and cash flow to operating performance.
* Apply economic thinking to capital allocation, opportunity cost, resource constraints, investment prioritization, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Identify and quantify material variances between actual performance and the assumptions supporting approved investments.
* Develop fact-based analyses and scenarios that clarify leadership trade-offs and recommended actions.

4. Operational Insight & Pattern Recognition

* Identify patterns, anomalies, systemic gaps, emerging constraints, and leading indicators across financial and operational data.
* Challenge inconsistencies among operating results, forecasts, capacity models, project plans, and financial expectations.
* Validate key assumptions with plant, engineering, supply-chain, finance, and project teams at the source.
* Translate operating issues into their financial, customer, capacity, and strategic implications and trigger timely corrective action.

5. Program Leadership & Execution

* Monitor delivery against schedule, cost, capacity, and expected business outcomes; surface deteriorating assumptions and missed dependencies early.
* Strengthen operating reviews by focusing on variance to commitment, root cause, get-to-green actions, accountable owners, timing, and leadership support required.
* Drive transparency and accountability while maintaining execution ownership within the responsible functions.
* Apply structured problem solving to complex cross-functional issues where ownership, data, or solutions are initially unclear.

6. Executive, Board & Investment Communications

* Develop executive and Board materials covering manufacturing strategy, capacity, investments, acquisitions, operational performance, risks, and decisions.
* Prepare CIMs, investment memoranda, acquisition assessments, diligence materials, and strategic decision papers.
* Translate complex operational, financial, and technical analysis into concise business narratives that state what changed, why it matters, the quantified impact, risks, actions, and decisions required.
* Anticipate executive questions and ensure recommendations withstand rigorous analytical review.

**Candidate Profile**

Experience

* 7–10 years of progressive experience preferred; exceptional candidates with 5–7 years of highly relevant experience will be considered.
* Experience in industrial Operations, Supply Chain and Finance Operations
* Demonstrated experience evaluating acquisitions, strategic investments, or vertical-integration opportunities.
* Experience with industrial, engineered-product, manufacturing, supply-chain-intensive, or capital-intensive businesses.
* Track record leading complex cross-functional workstreams with significant financial and organizational implications.
* Experience presenting analyses and recommendations to senior executives; Board exposure is advantageous.
* Education
* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related analytical discipline.
* MBA or advanced degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a quantitative field is preferred but not required.

**Critical Capabilities**

**Business acumen**

Rapidly understands how a business makes money, its economic drivers, sources of competitive advantage, and where value can be created or destroyed.

**Financial and investment acumen**

Strong command of financial statements, valuation, cash flow, working capital, NPV/IRR, ROIC, sensitivity analysis, and business-case development.

**M&A judgment**

Understands buy-side diligence, investment theses, synergy assumptions, integration risks, and value-capture requirements.

**Pattern recognition**

Detects trends, inconsistencies, weak assumptions, emerging risks, and signals within complex financial and operating information.

**Operational acumen**

Understands manufacturing economics, flow, capacity, bottlenecks, productivity, investment requirements, and execution risks.

**Executive synthesis**

Distills complex analysis into clear insights, implications, recommendations, and decisions.

**Constructive challenge**

Independently validates conclusions and has the courage to challenge senior stakeholders when facts, assumptions, or performance do not align.

**Success Measures****asure**

**Investment quality**

100% of major investment and acquisition recommendations supported by a

documented strategic rationale, operational assessment, financial model, sensitivity

analysis, and risk view.

**Value realization**

Approved investments and acquisitions have baselined benefit measures, accountable owners, and a recurring cadence to track capacity, productivity, synergy, margin, cash-flow, and ROIC outcomes.

**Early risk detection**

Material schedule, cost, capacity, and value-realization risks are surfaced with

quantified impact and recovery actions before they compromise committed outcomes.

**Manufacturing readiness**

Critical-path milestones and dependencies across equipment, engineering,

supply chain, systems, staffing, training, and ramp are visible and actively managed.

**Forecast integrity**

Material deviations from approved business cases and operating assumptions are identified, quantified, and escalated through the operating cadence.

**Decision effectiveness**

Executive reviews consistently provide alternatives, economics, risks,

recommendations, and explicit decisions required, not status reporting alone.

**Communication quality**

Executive and Board materials are fact-based, concise, decision-oriented,

and supported by traceable analysis.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a strategist, investor, economist, and operator.This individual is intellectually sharp, highly analytical, commercially minded, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. They can move from a financial model or acquisition thesis to the manufacturing floor, identify where facts do not support assumptions, and convert the insight into a compelling executive recommendation.

card.title: Plant Manager II
card.description:
**Description**

**Plant Manager II**

At Pilgrim’s, *Safety Is A Condition*, which means the safety of our team members comes first - always.

Pilgrim’s is seeking a **Plant Manager II** to lead and direct overall operations of a poultry processing facility. This role is responsible for ensuring production, quality, safety, and financial objectives are achieved while maintaining operational efficiency and controlling costs. The Plant Manager II provides leadership across all plant functions, including production, maintenance, purchasing, accounting, administration, and continuous improvement initiatives, while developing high-performing teams and driving operational excellence.

The **Plant Manager II** oversees a diverse leadership team and is accountable for plant performance, regulatory compliance, team member safety, product quality, customer satisfaction, and profitability. This position partners closely with corporate and complex leadership to execute strategic initiatives, support business growth, and foster a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement. If you're a results-driven leader with a passion for people development and operational excellence, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact within one of the industry's leading food companies.

**Responsibilities & Essential Duties:**

* Directs production and ensures cost effectiveness and consistency with prescribed quality, accuracy, and performance standards.
* Maintains plant property and equipment in good condition to ensure compliance with governmental regulations and to ensure effective and economical operations.
* Prepares and submits operating reports to management to inform them of the current production status and to make recommendations to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Assures effective customer service and relations through timely delivery of quality product.
* Selects, trains, develops, and motivates manufacturing staff to maintain plant operation.
* Assures compliance of all plant operations with company policy and federal, state, and local regulations.
* May set production and processing goals for plant.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of DIRECTLY RELATED experience in a poultry processing plant.
* High School Diploma/GED; Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a related field. DIRECTLY RELATED work experience will be accepted on a year-for-year basis in lieu of the educational requirement.

**Why Work for Pilgrim’s?**

* **Schedule:** Monday – Friday with occasional weekends.
* **Benefits**: Vision, Medical, and Dental coverage begin after 60 days of employment;
* **Paid Time Off:** Sick leave, vacation, company observed holidays or, any other statutorily required paid leave;
* **401(k):** company match begins after the first year of service and follows the company vesting schedule;
* **Base salary** range of $148,818 - $186,761;
* **Discretionary Bonus:** This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s annual bonusplan, the amount of bonus varies and is subject to the standard terms and conditions of the incentive program;
* **Career Development:** Our company is dedicated to supporting professional growth by offering continuous learning opportunities and a focus on career growth through various learning and development programs;
* **Better Futures**

The Company is dedicated to ensuring a safe and secure environment for our team members and visitors. To assist in achieving that goal, we conduct drug, alcohol, and background checks for all new team members post-offer and prior to the start of employment. The Immigration Reform and Control Act requires that verification of employment eligibility be documented for all new employees by the end of the third day of work.

**About Us:** Pilgrim’s is a leading global food company with more than 62,000 team members worldwide. The company processes, prepares, packages, and delivers fresh, frozen, and value-added food products for customers in more than 100 countries. Pilgrim’s operates protein processing plants and prepared foods facilities in 14 states, Puerto Rico, Mexico, the U.K, the Republic of Ireland and continental Europe.

**Our Vision:** To become the best and most respected company in our industry creating the opportunity of a better future for our team members.

**Our Core Values Are:** Availability, Determination, Discipline, Humility, Ownership, Simplicity, Sincerity

**EOE, including disability/vets**

**Unsolicited Assistance:** Pilgrim's does not accept unsolicited assistance from any recruitment vendors for any of our open jobs. All resumes or candidate profiles submitted by recruitment vendors or headhunters to any employee at Pilgrim's or via the applicant tracking system, in any form without a valid written request and search agreement previously approved by HR, will be solely owned by Pilgrim's. No fees will be paid should the candidate be hired by Pilgrim's because of an unsolicited referral.

card.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Manufacturing Investigations
card.description:
**Job summary**
---------------

The Manager, Manufacturing Investigations, position is strategically intended to support continuous process improvement by developing and leading a team of investigators in analyzing cross-functional non-conformance events (“Deviations”), defining root cause, assessing product impact, and implementing Corrective/ Preventive actions. The Manager should possess proven technical writing and problem-solving skills as well as a desire for developing investigators in the art of problem-solving analysis. This is a direct supervisor position also responsible for the training and development of the investigators as well as for their overall performance. An understanding of Biotechnology Upstream, Downstream, and Support principles with experience in non-conformance management is ideal.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* The Manager is responsible for oversight of the Manufacturing Operations’ deviation performance. The incumbent is responsible for the assignment of the deviations, ensuring departmental deviation ownership is balanced and appropriately distributed to facilitate timely and quality closure.
* Train and mentor a team of investigators to conduct comprehensive investigations to determine root cause, product impact and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Methodically investigate and troubleshoot Manufacturing deviations using defined troubleshooting and investigational techniques. Develop and implement preventive actions to reduce the potential of recurrence or proactively prevent the occurrence of a new deviation.
* Ensure non-conformance investigations meet or exceed the rigor of internal, client and regulatory reviewers.

------------------------

* BA/BS Degree in a science field preferred (i.e., Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, etc.) or equivalent combination of education and experience; 10+ years of pharmaceutical or related work experience with emphasis on current Good Manufacturing Practices including QA, QC, Validation, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
Plant Manager

**Company:** Smitty Bee Honey - Defiance, IA

**Reports to:** President

Job Summary

SBH is seeking an experienced, results-driven Plant Manager to coordinate and direct all major plant functions. You will oversee manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations while fostering positive employee relations and managing operational budgets. The ideal candidate will ensure strict compliance with SBH policies, food safety regulations, and legal requirements, while driving continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations & Production Management:** Oversee daily manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations, ensuring production schedules and product quality consistently meet specifications.
* **Customer Fulfillment:** Coordinate and communicate scheduled open orders to guarantee on-time delivery to all SBH customers, supporting strategic efforts to retain existing business and generate new sales.
* **Continuous Improvement & Efficiency:** Identify and implement initiatives to reduce labor costs, material waste, and indirect expenses. Develop and manage labor utilization strategies that adapt effectively to shifting production demands and deadlines.
* **Equipment & Facility Optimization:** Partner with Engineering and Maintenance to minimize equipment downtime. Manage process flows, optimize plant layouts, and coordinate shutdowns and startups for new production lines and equipment installations.
* **Food Safety & Quality Culture:** Champion a strong food safety culture by ensuring strict site-wide adherence to Food Safety, Quality, HACCP, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* **Workplace Safety:** Actively monitor, support, and enforce all plant safety objectives and regulatory standards.

**Job Description**
Be part of the global Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Engineering leadership team driving factory improvements, product improvements for producibility and cost savings, manufacturing technology implementation, and new product development for Honeywell Aerospace.
 
 
We are hiring a Sr Director to lead the global ISC Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team for New Product Introduction (NPI) supporting programs across the Aerospace portfolio.
 
 
In this role, you will leverage your extensive product development experience and leadership skills. You will drive continuous improvement to develop new products, processes, and standards in support of the organization's business strategies with a direct impact on development program success. You will develop strategy, hold teams accountable and deliver high impact business results.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver NPI program objectives including product producibility, design-to-cost (DTC) targets, production readiness, and customer quality.
* Operate as a change agent to embed producibility into our core design processes.
* Build Employee Engagement and Skills through the development of standard work, clear roles and responsibilities, and effective training programs.
* Design and develop Management Operating Systems to ensure effective team operations, driving results to program and department objectives.
* Work closely with the SBU engineering team, Program Management, and ISC leaders to build cross-organizational alignment

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics
* 8 years of experience in New Product Development
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Experience working with suppliers on technical issues
* Track record of managing multiple projects with demonstrated results on a macro scale
* Experience leading a team with direct line reporting responsibility
* Abitlity to travel 30%

**Us Person Requirements**
Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.
 
 
**WE VALUE**

* Advanced degree in engineering or business
* Exceptional data analysis and communication skills
* Willingness to raise standards each year to drive organizational excellence
* Ability to make sound and timely judgments in ambiguous environment
* Ability to convey subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience.
* Diverse and global teaming and collaboration
* Balance between demand and capacity when establishing priorities for the organization.

**For Mn Candidates**
The annual base salary range for this position is $238,000-$297,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
This position is incentive eligible.
 
 
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 
 

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

card.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
* Monitor machine downtime and establish corrective action plans.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Manage capital equipment planning, justification and implementation.
* Ensure new equipment and processes are effectively integrated into production.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage operational performance against established budgets and financial targets.
* Monitor labor efficiency, overtime, scrap, rework, material usage, and machine utilization.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities.
* Support Supplier Development Activities
* Support Product Transfer activities which may include travel
* Drive capital expenditure planning and return-on-investment analysis.
* Understand the relationship between operational performance, cost, and EBITDA.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Conduct daily/weekly operational meetings and communicate priorities throughout the organization.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on production performance, capacity, quality, safety, and staffing.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Sales to resolve issues and support customer requirements.
* Escalate operational risks and develop action plans to address them.

***Physical Requirements*****:**

Required to sit, stand, bend, and lift up to 25 lbs.

***Work Environment*****:**

* Combination of Manufacturing and Office environment.
* Regular exposure to noise, dust, heat, cold and odors.

***Knowledge, Skills & Experiences*****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, preferably in a precision machining environment.
* 3+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with responsibility for people and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of CNC machining and machine shop operations.
* Experience with high-mix/low- to medium-volume manufacturing preferred.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience leading production teams and improving operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing safety practices and OSHA requirements.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

***Preferred Experience***

* Precision machining and tight-tolerance manufacturing
* CNC turning and milling
* Multi-axis machining
* High-mix manufacturing
* AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments
* Hazardous Waste Management

* Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* ERP/MRP systems
* Capital equipment implementation
* Continuous improvement / Kaizen
* P&L or operating-budget responsibility

card.title: Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality and Compliance
card.description:
#### **Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality & Compliance**

ProCompounding Pharmacy is seeking an experienced pharmacist to provide leadership across pharmacy operations, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and sterile and nonsterile compounding.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership position for someone who understands both the technical and operational demands of a growing 503A compounding pharmacy. The successful candidate will help strengthen our pharmacy infrastructure, develop our people, maintain regulatory readiness, and build practical systems that support quality, consistency, and continued growth.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **The Director of Pharmacy Operations, Quality and Compliance will:**

* Provide leadership and oversight for pharmacy operations, quality, and regulatory compliance.
* Support sterile and nonsterile compounding operations and ensure alignment with applicable standards and regulations.
* Maintain and continuously improve the pharmacy's quality management systems.
* Oversee compliance with USP 795, 797, and 800 requirements.
* Lead preparation for regulatory inspections, accreditation surveys, and internal quality reviews.
* Manage investigations, deviations, rootcause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and related quality initiatives.
* Develop practical policies, procedures, and operating systems that improve consistency and accountability.
* Coach, develop, and support pharmacy team members and emerging leaders.
* Partner with ownership and leadership on operational priorities, risk management, and growth initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments and help ensure compliance across multiple states.

#### **Ideal Background**

#### **Strong candidates will bring:**

* Pharmacist licensure and significant experience within a 503A compounding pharmacy.
* Leadership experience involving pharmacy operations, quality, compliance, or staff management.
* Experience with both sterile and nonsterile compounding strongly preferred.
* Board Certification in Sterile Compounding Pharmacy (BCSCP) preferred.
* Working knowledge of USP 795, 797, and 800.
* Experience with inspections, accreditation, investigations, CAPA processes, and quality improvement.
* The ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical operating processes.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, and problemsolving skills.
* Experience working within a multistate pharmacy environment.

Experience in 503B outsourcing facilities, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or cGMP environments would be an additional advantage.

Multistate pharmacist licensure is not required.

#### **The Opportunity**

ProCompounding is a growing organization where senior leaders remain close to the work. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys building systems, solving problems, developing people, and taking ownership rather than operating within a highly layered corporate structure.

We are open to qualified candidates nationally and are willing to discuss relocation for the right individual. Experienced professionals who are ready to expand their leadership responsibilities are encouraged to apply.

#### **About ProCompounding Pharmacy**

MISSION: At ProCompounding Pharmacy, we provide personalized medications tailored to meet each individual's specific health requirements. With a commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation, we stand at the forefront of pharmaceutical compounding, bridging the gap between traditional pharmacy and cutting-edge healthcare solutions. OUR SERVICES: We specialize in compounding services, including: \* Hormone Replacement Therapy \* Pediatric Compounding \* Veterinary Compounding \* Dermatology and Wound Care \* Pain Management \* Dental Compounding \* Over the counter supplements Each service is conducted with the highest standards, using pharmaceutical-grade ingredients and state-of-the-art compounding techniques. Our pharmacists work closely with healthcare providers to develop formulations that address our patients' precise needs.

This opportunity is located within our **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company** business, a global leader of mission-critical hardware and systems solutions including precision energetics systems and innovative explosive solutions.

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Quality Management – APS is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the enterprise quality management program across all APS services. This role ensures service excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction through standardized processes, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.

This leader partners with enterprise functions and operational stakeholders to document, standardize, and scale quality-of-service delivery across current and future APS sites. Responsibilities include developing quality frameworks, policies, playbooks, training programs, and performance reporting while driving actionable improvements aligned with APS Operating System, company initiatives and industry best practices.

To design, implement, and sustain a comprehensive quality management system that enhances efficiency, performance, and consistency across APS services while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, APS Operating System, ABM standards, and client commitments. The role promotes a culture of continuous improvement and leverages technology and data to support operational excellence and client retention.

* Develop and execute an enterprise quality strategy aligned with APS Operating System, and ABM business objectives.
* Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program, including standards, governance, measurement frameworks, training, audits, and reporting.
* Establish and enforce quality control standards across all APS service lines.
* Lead audits and assessments and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, safety, environmental, and industry standards (e.g., OSHA, ISO, APPA).
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and cost performance.
* Collaborate with Client Experience and operational leaders to drive consistency and improve customer satisfaction.
* Develop KPIs and reporting to provide insights to senior leadership.
* Build training programs and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Support special projectsand additional responsibilities as assigned.

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Project Management, Facility Management, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g., Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO) preferred.
* 8–10 years of quality management experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience with enterprise systems supporting the built environment (CMMS, BAS, BMS, IWMS).
* Proficiency in data analysis and quality management tools.
* Familiarity with emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, VR, and smart building solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to lead change in a matrixed environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to travel up to 60%.

card.description:
**Why Us?**

At Par Health, we believe great healthcare is built on getting the essentials right. We’re looking for passionate, talented individuals who share our commitment to improving lives. With a global workforce, we lead with pride and purpose—prioritizing quality and safety while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and teamwork. Elevating the Essentials isn’t just our tagline, it’s the higher standard we live by every day.

**Job Description Summary**

The Site Quality Director is responsible for ensuring cGMP compliance and product quality at the Raleigh, NC facility while supporting broader site quality initiatives aligned with company objectives. This role provides strategic leadership in the development, implementation, and oversight of the site quality systems to ensure that all manufacturing, testing, packaging, storage, and distribution activities meet regulatory standards and deliver the highest product quality. The Site Quality Director leads and mentors quality teams, oversees daily quality operations, and serves as a key partner to site leadership by providing guidance on quality and compliance across the organization.

**Job Description**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Manages all aspects of Site Quality System including but not limited to: CAPA, exceptions, document management, complaint investigation handling, change control, supplier quality, OOS investigations, stability programs, and regulatory inspection readiness.**
* **Support a quality program which instils personal accountability for accuracy, consistency, and completeness for all operations**
* **Provides direction and leadership for the successful execution of quality activities, such as:**
* **Ensures health authority inspection (FDA, EU, Health Canada and others) readiness through development of compliance enhancement plans, internal audit program, and industry intelligence.**
* **Customer complaint investigation, including interaction with customers and resolution of critical issues.**
* **Manages the supplier quality program to fulfill regulatory and site needs.**
* **Conducts and/or administers new employee, ongoing, and directed training on GMP topics to ensure compliance to regulations. Manages site training compliance program.**
* **CAPA program to effectively identify and correct problems that impact product quality or compliance.**
* **Validation activities for new, altered, or modified equipment, facilities, or manufacturing processes.**
* **Customer audit process (approximately 50/yr.) to include preparation, hosting, and responding to issues noted – also, utilize input from customer audits and a continuous improvement tool.**
* **Documents management and label control to fulfill regulatory and business needs**
* **Stability program for both API products manufactured at the site.**
* **Approves highly technical investigations involving product impact.**
* **Sets direction and policies for cGMP compliance activities.**
* **Schedules employees through subordinates, performance appraisals, and performance management of team members.**
* **Budgets and adherence for areas of functional responsibility.**
* **Directly interacting with key customers relating to technical issues, potential non-compliance activities, or service issues impacted by quality/compliance.**
* **Resolution of critical quality issues that could impact production, customer service, quality, or compliance.**
* **Interprets regulatory guidance to determine site course of action for compliance.**
* **Technical expert in multiple quality functional areas, such as validation, product investigations, quality systems, and establishing compliance plans, etc.**

**DEPARTMENT** **SPECIFIC/NON-ESSENTIAL** **FUNCTIONS:**

* **Other duties as assigned with or without accommodation.**
* **Participates in a certified 5S Workplace System to ensure good housekeeping and organization.**

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

**BS Chemistry, Engineering, Life Science or related.**

**Experience:**

**7-10 years leadership experience in a chemical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, preferably specific to Quality and/or manufacturing related functions.**

**Preferred** **Skills/Qualifications:**

* **Working knowledge of chemical, pharmaceutical or bio-pharmaceutical manufacturing.**
* **Must have knowledge and understanding of applicable global regulations, GMP and compendial requirements.**
* **Must have thorough knowledge and understanding of QA regulations as they apply to this type of facility.**
* **Experience in driving improvements in quality systems and quality performance is preferred.**
* **Certification as a Six Sigma Black or Green Belt and/or as a Certified Quality Engineer is considered a plus.**
* **Must have high technical ability and excellent** **interpersonal/communication** **skills. Requires excellent oral and written skills and good negotiation skills to effectively communicate and influence the outcome of quality related plans, programs, and activities throughout the business unit.**
* **Must have the ability and experience to drive cost reduction while continuously improving performance, as well as the ability to lead employees in making these changes.**

**RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHERS/ SCOPE:**

* **This position reports to the Interim Head of Quality, Generics.**
* **This position will have frequent communication and working relationships with departments and plant managers.**
* **Interacts with internal Staff (Department and Plant Managers) on all Site management issues. Advises Staff on compliance issues. Report on overall performance and critical quality issues to Corporate Quality. Interacts with Corporate Quality personnel, R&D, and quality and managers within the organization. Works with Commercial team on customer issues. External contacts include regulatory authorities, state, federal and international (FDA, OSHA, EPA, NCDENR), suppliers, customers and community contacts.**
* **Financial responsibilities include managing multi-million payroll and operating budgets. Also recommends major purchases and capital expenditures that are necessary to maintain operations of QC laboratory and to maintain or improve the site’s GMP compliance and performance.**

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* **70% Office Environment** 
 **30% Laboratory and Plant environment including exposure to raw materials and finished products**
* **Must be willing and able to wear PPE including hard-hat, steel-toed shoes, safety glasses, and any other devices or equipment as specified for the position.**
* **Some travel is required, both domestically and internationally.**

**DISCLAIMER:**

**The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this** **classification.** **They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of employees assigned to this position.**

**EEO Statement:**

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment, and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

card.title: Director, Quality II - IRF
card.description:
**Facility Name:** North Florida Rehabilitation Hospital

**Schedule: Day Shift, Full Time**

**Your experience matters**

North Florida Rehabilitation Hospital is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As a **Director of Quality** joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to *making communities healthier* *®*. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

**How you’ll contribute**

Leads and oversees a comprehensive, efficient, and integrated hospital-wide Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement (CQPI) program. Uses data collection, analysis, and trending to assess performance; focuses on process and systems improvement; directs risk management and patient safety activities; investigates adverse outcomes; coordinates regulatory/accreditation readiness; and educates staff on CQPI and related quality programs.

**Essential Functions**

* Provide leadership and oversight of the organization-wide CQPI program.
* Measure and assess performance by collecting, analyzing, and trending data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Focus on improving processes and systems to drive clinical quality, safety, and operational performance.
* Direct, facilitate, and report on all aspects of risk management and patient safety.
* Investigate factors contributing to adverse outcomes and drive process/system changes.
* Direct the hospital-wide CQPI operations, including record reviews for quality indicators and reporting findings to leadership, Medical Executive Committee, Board of Managers, and other committees.
* Annually review hospital-wide plans for Infection Control (IC) and CQPI; establish goals and objectives for the coming year.
* Serve as liaison to local health officials; coordinate inspections and accreditation reviews with state and other regulatory agencies.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional Information**

Develops and delivers hospital-wide CQPI education and training. Prepares quality/patient safety reports and dashboards for leaders and committees. Partners with clinical and non-clinical departments to sustain improvements and ensure compliance with applicable standards.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

**Licensure:** Registered Nurse with current state licensure highly preferred; clinical license required.

**Education:** BSN or BS/BA required.

**Experience:** Minimum two (2) years in an acute hospital or rehabilitation setting required; prior supervisory experience preferred.

**Certifications:** Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) required; certification preferred by APIC (American Practitioners of Infection Control) and NAHCQ (National Association of Health Care Quality).

**Skills:** Data analysis and reporting; CQPI methodologies (e.g., RCA, FMEA, PDSA); risk management and patient safety facilitation; regulatory/accreditation readiness; effective teaching, communication, and collaboration.

card.title: Sr Manager, Quality Assurance Engineering (Hybrid - Acton, MA)
card.description:
Job Summary

This role is responsible for leading quality operations within a manufacturing plant, ensuring products and processes meet regulatory, company, and customer quality standards. The position manages quality systems, quality control personnel, supplier quality performance, product release activities, and compliance with FDA and ISO requirements while supporting both ongoing production and new product introductions. The Quality Manager works closely with manufacturing, engineering, suppliers, and corporate teams to drive continuous improvement, investigate and resolve quality issues through root cause analysis, oversee audits and inspections, develop quality training programs, and establish key performance metrics. Candidates should have a bachelor's degree in a technical field, experience in an FDA-regulated industry, strong knowledge of quality systems and statistical methods, and a proven ability to lead teams and drive positive change.



Position Overview:
 
Manages manufacturing plant quality programs, processes, activities, and Responsibilities: supporting current operations and new product introductions. Manages quality control personnel in the execution of their quality related duties. Interacts with other manufacturing departments (production, maintenance, engineering etc.) as well as with HQ support personnel, suppliers and other external parties on issues related to quality.
 
 
Responsibilities:
 

* Establish and maintain a manufacturing Quality Management System and team that contributes to outstanding customer service and promotes the highest standards for product quality.
* Plans, organizes, directs and reports on all quality assurance engineering related activities such as product components, manufacturing in-process controls, product release.
* Ensure incoming parts/materials are within specification and all required documents are complete and accurate.
* Identify QC test procedures and equipment required to maintain high product quality.
* Ensure suppliers are performing tolerance/specification testing, utilizing Insulet’s prescribed test methods, procedures and equipment.
* Make sure released product meets specifications and predetermined criteria to ensure Pod and sub assembly manufacturing is in compliance and control through lot Qualification process and procedures.
* Lead and execute root cause analysis to determine failure causes and implement failure reduction and elimination strategies.
* Suggest methods for improving product quality, design, or manufacturing processes
* Develop and/or manage quality programs and training, complete with tools and processes that support an operational excellence environment and ensure compliance with all company and Federal audit requirements.
* Establish key quality KPI’s and score carding/tracking mechanisms to ensure continuous improvement.
* Manage existing and create new, if necessary, quality gates to ensure Incoming Quality Assurance, Pod and sub assembly manufacturing are in compliance and control.
* Ensure plant policies and procedures are in compliance with all FDA regulations.
* Engage with suppliers and supplier development group in monitoring supplier quality performance.
* Serve as a team member and leader to provide quality expertise to other manufacturing functional teams.
* Work cross functionally with HQ and field personnel to promote understanding and cooperation for the quality agenda.
* Lead all quality and regulatory inspections and audits, as well as the completion of all action items in a timely manner.
* Maintain all internal and external quality documents and prepare required reports in a timely manner.
* Develop and implement training programs and best practices required to maintain high-quality standards.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

 
Education and Experience:
 
Minimum Requirements:
 

* BS degree in engineering, a technical or scientific discipline; and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the FDA regulated environment.
* Experience in Quality in an FDA regulated industry.

 
Preferred Skills and Competencies:
 

* Have knowledge, experience and understanding of the tenets of Six Sigma Process and other statistical analysis tools (SPC) required to maintain high standards. Six Sigma black belt preferred.
* Have knowledge and understanding of ISO programs.
* High proficiency with software that is centered on process management and statistical data analysis.
* Successful experience in factory level quality, production and / or maintenance management.
* Effective verbal and excellent technical writing skills.
* Ability to communicate at multiple levels of an organization.
* Ability to organize and judge priorities.
* Excels at generating and maintaining organized and accurate records.
* Knowledge of Quality principles using statistics and SPC tools.
* PC skill, word processing, spreadsheet, database.
* Able to work effectively in a high-stress, high-energy environment.
* Able to make effective decisions quickly based on vague or imperfect information.
* Great interpersonal skills.
* Track record of leading positive change.

*NOTE: This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements (requires on-site work from an Insulet office). #LI-Hybrid*

Additional Information:

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.
 
 
We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

card.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
card.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

card.description:
**Revvity**

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity.

Our team is seeking a Director, Quality Operations to lead site quality for the Hopkinton-based operation. This role succeeds the current site quality leadership position and is intentionally scoped at the Director level because it combines broad operational accountability, organizational build-out, and a significant quality-system integration mandate. The Director will lead a blended Quality Operations organization spanning product quality, quality systems, supplier and incoming quality, inspection, and production support. The successful leader must protect ongoing product quality and compliance while progressively simplifying, integrating, and modernizing the operating model.

 
 

**Routine Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

**Site Quality Leadership and Governance**
------------------------------------------

* Quality Operations leader for Hopkinton, with accountability for product quality, manufacturing quality, inspection, release, and site QMS execution.

* Provide visible, hands-on leadership in production and laboratory environments, enabling rapid risk-based decisions and timely escalation of material, process, product, and compliance issues.

* Own the site quality operating rhythm, including management review, quality metrics, risk review, resource prioritization, and cross-functional governance with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, R&D, Regulatory, Service, and Commercial teams.

* Serve as the principal site Quality representative for FDA, ISO, notified-body, customer, and internal audits, and ensure sustained inspection readiness across the blended operation.

* Balance product continuity, customer commitments, compliance, and transformation priorities using documented risk-based decisions.

 
 

**QMS, SOP, and Digital-System Integration**
--------------------------------------------

* Create and execute a phased roadmap improve and sustain SOPs and QMS structures supporting the site, with clear process ownership, sequencing, change controls, validation needs, and business-continuity safeguards.

* Optimize operating model for document control, production records, training, calibration, internal audits, supplier management, incoming inspection, final acceptance, complaints, and customer field interfaces.

* Lead the integration and modernization of quality tools and records currently distributed across systems and methods.

* Partner with enterprise Quality, Regulatory, IT/Digital, and business process owners to deploy scalable solutions and eliminate duplicate or conflicting workflows, records, and controls.

* Ensure data integrity, validated-state control, traceability, retention, access, and training are maintained throughout system and process transitions.

 
 

**Product and Manufacturing Quality**
-------------------------------------

* Lead quality support for a diverse portfolio that includes instruments, consumables and reagents platforms.

* Oversee incoming inspection, in-process controls, final product acceptance and release, nonconformance and material-review processes, manufacturing investigations, and CAPA effectiveness.

* Ensure appropriate validation and verification of manufacturing processes, equipment, software-enabled tools, inspection methods, and test methods.

* Drive preventive product-quality improvements using defect, yield, scrap, complaint, service, supplier, and Cost of Poor Quality trends.

* Represent Quality in design transfer, manufacturing transfer, new-product introduction, supplier changes, capacity expansion, and sustaining-engineering decisions.

 
 

**Organization Build and People Leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team of Quality Systems, Product Quality, Supplier/Incoming Quality, Quality Control, inspection, technician, and specialist roles.

* Implement planned organization expansion, including Quality Systems leadership, compliance coordination, QC supervision, and temporary integration support, while clarifying accountability across product and system responsibilities.

* Build succession depth and technical capability through coaching, performance management, role clarity, development plans, and targeted cross-training across legacy product and QMS environments.

* Set clear performance expectations and foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, timely decision-making, and practical continuous improvement.

* Plan resource needs and manage the site Quality Operations budget, contractor usage, and external support in line with the operating plan.

 
 

**Customer, Supplier, and Compliance Interface**
------------------------------------------------

* Own the Quality Operations response to significant customer issues, quality agreements, customer audits, field escalations, and product-quality communications in partnership with Commercial Quality and Regulatory.

* Provide governance for supplier quality and incoming-quality activities, including risk-based controls, supplier corrective action, change assessment, and escalation of supply continuity risks.

* Ensure complaints, quality events, CAPAs, deviations, nonconformances, and risk-management activities are documented, investigated, assessed, and closed with appropriate rigor and timeliness.

* Responsible for customer complaint handling and investigations in collaboration with cross functional teams driving problem solving and resolution plans.

Maintain effective QMS training, document control, internal audit, calibration, and records-management programs across the site scope.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* bachelors degree
* 15+ years of quality experience with 7+ years management experience
 

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting instruments, reagents and consumable product lines and systems.
* Experience deploying or consolidating eQMS, ERP, PLM, inspection, training, document-control, or calibration systems.
* Lean, Six Sigma, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, or comparable credentials.
* Experience hosting regulatory and customer audits and managing complex customer-quality interfaces.
* Experience with data analysis, analytics, and management reporting schemes.
 

 

**Physical Requirements & Expectations:**

* The primary working condition associated with this position is working independently in the office environment.
* It is frequently required to work cross-functionally. Travel may be required up to 10%.
* Requires the ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds, sit and/or stand for prolonged periods of time and effectively manage conflict and emotional or stressful situations.
* Potential hazards associated with blood products.

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

 
 

**Compensation Range:**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $159,000 - $185,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for a new hire in this position. The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account internal equity, work location, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that base pay is only one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This range allows for the successful candidate to have an opportunity to progress within the position and develop at our company. This base pay range does not take into account bonuses, equity, or other benefits which may be applicable and are dependent on the level and position offered.

#LI-CH1

 
 
 

**What do we offer?**

We provide competitive and comprehensive benefits to our employees. Below are some highlights of our benefits:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Options
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Paid Time-Off
* Parental Benefits
* Compassionate Care Leave
* 401k with Company Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Learn more about Revvity’s benefits by visiting our Bswift (opens in new window) page. Log-In instructions are provided towards the bottom of the Bswift page.

*For benefit-eligible roles only. Part-time and temporary roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed. Please reach out to your recruiter for more information.*

**Recruitment Scam Alert**

We've become aware that scammers are impersonating members of our recruitment team by using fake email addresses and fraudulent job opportunities.

Please remember:

We will never ask you to pay for an interview, job offer, equipment, training, or any part of our recruitment process. Always verify that recruitment emails come from our official company email domain (revvity.com). Revvity will never conduct interviews via text message, messaging apps, or social media direct messages. If you're ever unsure whether a recruitment message is genuine, please contact us through our official careers website before responding.
 
 
Your safety is important to us.
 
If you believe you've been targeted by recruitment fraud in the United States, you can report it to the Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at https://www.ic3.gov/ or the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) at https://reportfraud.ftc.gov .
